defs.def: the feelings that you have in your body when you have been hurt or when you are ill/sick （身体上的）疼痛

ex.s: I felt a small pain in my chest The dictionary was stolen at the end of my freshman year of college.
ex.t: 我胸口隐隐作痛——那本词典在我大一结束时被偷了。

ex.s: Hardly had I written half a page when I felt a sharp pain in my chest
ex.t: 刚写了不到半页，我就感到胸口一阵剧痛。

ex.s: “I actually think the medicine is only a small piece for some problems,” says Julie Good, director of pain management services at LPCH.
ex.t: 「我认为药物对某些问题来说只是一小部分作用，」LPCH疼痛管理服务主任Julie Good说。

ex.s: He became interested in alternative treatments 20 years ago when he suffered from terrible back pain.
ex.t: 20年前，当他遭受严重背痛时，他对替代疗法产生了兴趣。

ex.s: While many species’ thought processes are limited to “Food, eat it!”, “Danger, run!”, “Pain, avoid!”, we’ve evolved beyond that.
ex.t: 虽然许多物种的思维过程仅限于「食物，吃了它！」「危险，快跑！」「疼痛，避开！」，但我们已经进化得超越了这个阶段。

ex.s: As reported by a local newspaper, Bailey was more than two-thirds of the way through her ____24____ when a runner in front of her began crying in pain.
ex.t: 据当地一家报纸报道，贝利在____24____已完成超过三分之二时，她前面的一名跑步者开始痛苦地哭喊。

ex.s: Their experience of pain is reduced.
ex.t: 他们的疼痛体验减轻。

ex.s: A total of 92 women were in the medium fitness category; and 59 women were in the low fitness category, defined as a peak workload of 80 watts or less, or having their exercise tests stopped because of high blood pressure, chest pain or other cardiovascular problems.
ex.t: 共有92名女性处于中等健康类别；59名女性处于低健康类别，定义为峰值工作负荷80瓦特或以下，或因高血压、胸痛或其他心血管问题而停止运动测试。

ex.s: But Jeff’s hand touched the hot burner and he gave a cry of pain.
ex.t: 但Jeff的手碰到了滚烫的炉灶，他痛得叫了一声。

ex.s: But Jeff’s hand touched the hot burner and he gave a cry of pain.
ex.t: 但Jeff的手碰到了滚烫的炉灶，他痛得叫了一声。

ex.s: “After a long run, you may feel like you’re in pain, you may feel tired.
ex.t: "长跑之后，你可能会觉得痛苦，你可能会觉得累。

ex.s: Despite the pain, I stayed the course walking a bit and then running again.
ex.t: 尽管疼痛，我仍坚持走下去，走一会儿再跑一会儿。

ex.s: However, here are some examples: being cut off in traffic, a deadline approaching, experiencing physical pain, and much more. ____52____ The reason why someone is triggered by something and others are not is often due to one’s personal history and psychological traits.
ex.t: 然而，这里有一些例子：在车流中被加塞、截止日期临近、经历身体上的疼痛，等等。____52____ 某人被某事触发而他人没有，原因往往在于个人的经历和心理特质。

ex.s: Maybe the first plant just made a cry of pain or was sending a message to its own branches, and so, in effect, was talking to itself.
ex.t: 也许第一株植物只是发出了痛苦的呼喊，或者是在向自己的枝条传递信息，因此实际上是在自言自语。

ex.s: Maybe the first plant just made a cry of pain or was sending a message to its own branches, and so, in effect, was talking to itself.
ex.t: 也许第一株植物只是发出了痛苦的呼喊，或者是在向自己的枝条传递信息，因此实际上是在自言自语。

ex.s: But again they had to move away because of the pain caused by the other porcupines’ quills.
ex.t: 但由于其他豪猪的刺造成的疼痛，它们不得不再次分开。

ex.s: Since getting here, Lara has spent her time crying in pain.
ex.t: 到这里后，劳拉一直疼得在哭。

ex.s: Some children, though, don’t feel like laughing, especially if they're in pain.
ex.t: 不过，有些孩子并不想笑，尤其是在他们疼痛的时候。

ex.s: Although she is clearly still in some pain, her scared and anxious look has been replaced —first by a small smile, and then by loud laughter as I "magically" produce her sock from out of my pocket.
ex.t: 尽管她显然还有些疼痛，但她那惊恐不安的表情已经被取代了——先是一个小小的微笑，然后当我「变魔术般」地从口袋里掏出她的袜子时，变成了大笑。

defs.def: mental or emotional suffering 痛苦；苦恼；烦恼

ex.s: I took my time petting the cat-postponing the pain.
ex.t: 我慢悠悠地抚摸着猫——以此推迟那即将到来的痛苦。

ex.s: No pain, no gain ,as the saying goes.
ex.t: 俗话说得好：一分耕耘，一分收获。

defs.def: a person or thing that is very annoying 讨厌的人（或事）；令人头痛的人（或事）
